dispute.claim_text: Three times the same car. Three times he didn't move. When I called he cursed at me and said he was busy on another app. Then I cancelled because what else, and I paid for it. Support hotline rang for half a second and hung up.

counterparty_statement.text: The app kept throwing the same booking at me. I was finishing a job elsewhere. I told her to cancel so she could get someone else.
